grid_law: For each index, enumerate (u,v) lexicographically with a1=47*u and a3=47*v; derive a2,a4,a6 by the fixed tangent formula
rank_method: For every valid curve, simon_two_descent with known Q and limbigprime=0; if and only if completed upper bound <=1, run proof-enabled Sage PARI rank with use_database=False, only_use_mwrank=True
status_law: Retain all 18 grid cells, including invalid, complete, error, and timeout; exact rank-one replacements require completed Simon upper bound <=1 and proof-enabled exact PARI rank 1
selection: first rank-one certified cell in lexicographic (u,v) order for each source index, without stopping the full grid
